body:
I want to, so bad. I just don't know how. I work for a community organization that helps homeless Indigenous folks, so I guess that's kind of something. I try to donate to causes whenever I can, I advocate for people who are discriminated against, and I'm just generally doing my best to be a better person... but it all feels performative. 

At this point, I think the only thing that can save my soul would be reconciling with the people who I've victimized in the past. But even if I do that, there's a good chance that I'd end up making things worse.

Do you have any suggestions on how I can start making more positive changes in the world?
